csv_project_name: As-Needed Civil engineering for Parks and Recreational
csv_scope_of_work: Leon County, Florida ( County ) is issuing this Request for Proposals ( RFP ) from qualified firms to provide Parks and Recreational Facility Engineering. Work in this category shall consist of design services related to Master Plans and design of county parks and/or landscape projects. Firms selected for this work category shall have a registered landscape architecture firm as part of the design team. Services may include, but are not limited to athletic fields, parking lots, park roads, landscape design, park structures, playground equipment, trails, drainage, and utilities in a park setting.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Sanitation Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering
